notes.title: Version 2.0: 1-Year Anniversary Bonus Scenario
notes.content:
[i]Quest Giver[/i] is 1 year old, and we're celebrating with a bonus scenario: [b]Reunion Party[/b]! Featuring new updated character portraits & office:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/f71c307200e566898e6a9566cb2298ee63d93a44.png[/img]
All of your favourite characters are back for a reunion party, but someone has gone missing... and it's up to you to solve the mystery! The scenario will unlock once you complete the game (credits scenario). We hope you enjoy this final bonus scenario <3

Now get to work!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/df9ba601211bd9c55b58e4b65aacc057d50ddbc2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/04af95cd8f969ef271417a35b2f4e75f43b15969.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: New cozy puzzle game by the makers of Quest Giver
notes.content:
Enjoy more fun and silly stories from us, but in puzzle format: flip the puzzle pieces and colour them correctly to reveal the full picture! Discover how each image leads into the next, following a crew of adorable animals as they make friends and have wholesome adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/82513e45db6ec36c34807fb1ef33077f89e03fca.png[/img]

We hope you like it! Also keep an eye out for an upcoming [i]Quest Giver[/i] update, the caped baldy has been up to something...!

notes.title: Version 1.3: France localization!
notes.content:
We're two bilingual developers from Quebec, so we released [i]Quest Giver[/i] in both English and French. However as more players popped up in France, it was made clear to us that Quebecois French and France French are substantially different, and that much of the slang and expressions we used just don't work for our European NPCs!

So now, we're pleased to announce a new language option: [b]France French[/b] ːsteamthumbsupː
Those who already play in French will be prompted once to pick their new localization of choice:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/7295caf518b27e23e6b46d9f93bb06cdd5426337.png[/img]


We're super grateful to  [url=https://ko-fi.com/aistacariel]Heksaeder [/url]who volunteered to go over the 2000+ lines of dialogue and Franced them up for us (while also catching numerous typos we'd missed), this wouldn't have been possible without you! We also adjusted the punctuation in the France version, using the proper quotation marks and spacing:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/6d121ceb5ccce0e15e3bee27ad690534026a8a30.png[/img]

Between the huge rewrite and the small presentation details, we hope this version of [i]Quest Giver[/i] is more comfy for everyone. Now get to work!

We've released the OST for [i]Quest Giver[/i] here on Steam, and with the current launch discount those who already bought the game can get still get a nice deal on the tunes.

It's also available on [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/4zvoOIG4Fg0Poh8jIZlgKL?si=kbXsHUujRa-hftrPvCufrQ]Spotify[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_lSUHWIuFhnkCnNUlR1JfFwDwzgRdIO_HM]Youtube[/url], and [url=https://darzalgames.bandcamp.com/album/quest-giver-ost]Bandcamp[/url] (and other music services) if you'd like to give it a listen.

notes.content:
Hey folks, just some quick bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed several UI input bugs (including one submitted by [i]TheChronicleHunter[/i], thanks!)

[/list]
Plus we've dotted some [b]cool[/b] text effects around the game for special dialogue:

notes.title: Version 1.1.1: Small clarity update + bug & crash fixes
notes.content:
There's a nice little update for all you NPCs today:
[list]
[*] Set the default font to CURVY for new players (since people find it easier to read, and by golly QG is a readin' game)
[*] Fixed a crash in [i]The World Needs a Hero[/i] if Krol is killed early and the goblin quest is ignored, thanks to [b]Kerolink[/b] for finding and reporting it! ːsteamthumbsupː
[*] Fixed some French and English typos
[*] Added a more noticeable scroll for important quest results:
[/list][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44697663/92557eda6b75c937fe6776521485bfce611b06a9.png[/img]

In other news: we're up to nearly [b]17 000 global quests succeeded[/b], well done everyone!

See you at the next update 💖
-Darzington & Zalinius

notes.title: Version 1.1: QoL, typos, and bugfixes
notes.content:
[b]Just a few quality-of-life and bugfix changes:[/b]

-The scenario map is now more intuitive for mouse-users (the current scenario button always spins, and there’s a text hint for how to exit the map)
-Pressing keyboard buttons like volume or media controls no longer puts you into keyboard input mode
-Fixed some typos
-Fixed some missing french text

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697663/47d3cad234e752c2f1ffeb673318768e8b51fa4a.gif[/img]

📜As always, feel free to submit a [url=https://forms.gle/9f9qgLELbsfpAjmW9]bug[/url] or [url=https://forms.gle/abfioousMBcmAUch9]feedback[/url], we appreciate it.
Happy quest giving, NPCs! 💖
